connectionSpecification.description: Reads the sites, sitemaps and daily search analytics, built-in and custom, of Google Search Console properties.

credentials.description: A service account key, or an OAuth client with the refresh token of a Google user. Either must be a user of every site in Search Console.

service_account_key.description: The JSON key of a service account of a Google Cloud project with the Google Search Console API enabled.
service_account_key.title: Service Account Key

client_id.description: Client ID of the Google Cloud OAuth client the refresh token was issued to.
client_id.title: OAuth Client ID

client_secret.description: Client secret of the OAuth client.
client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly scope.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

credentials.title: Authentication

custom_reports.description: Each report becomes a stream with its name, read by day for every site. date is added as the first dimension when missing. discover and googleNews do not support the query dimension.
custom_reports.title: Custom Reports

data_state.description: final reads only finalized data; all also reads fresh data that may still change.
data_state.title: Data State

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose search analytics are read; empty reads up to today (UTC).
end_date.title: End Date

lookback_days.description: Days before the saved date an incremental read starts again, since Search Console keeps updating recent days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

site_urls.description: Search Console properties to read: URL-prefix properties such as https://www.example.com/ or http://www.example.com/ (ending with /) and domain properties such as sc-domain:example.com. Every stream reads each of them.
site_urls.title: Site URLs

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose search analytics are read; empty reads the last 16 months, all Search Console keeps.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Google Search Console Source Spec
